tei:div.tei:p: // rgyal dbang kun dga' rin chen gyi thugs dam bkra shis sgo mang gi nang bzhugs kyi dkar chag rin chen bang mdzod ces bya ba bzhugs so//

/oṃ swa sti siddhi/ dus gsum rgyal ba'i rnam sprul rdo rje 'dzin// bka' brgyud bla ma rnams dang yi dam lha// bslu med dkon mchog gsum dang chos srung la// sgo gsum gus pas rtag tu phyag 'tshal lo// gangs can sgrub brgyud bstan 'dzin kun gyi mchog /'bri gung skyu ra 'jig rten gsum mgon zhes// klu sgrub sprul par 'dzam gling yongs su grags// rgyal dang rgyal ba'i sras kyis lung bstan pa// gang de'i rigs 'khrungs thugs kyi sprul par yang*// skyob pa'i lung bstan kun dga' rin chen gyis// thugs dam bkra shis sgo mang slar yang bzhengs// nang bzhugs dkar chag rin chen bang mdzod bri// kun khyab gzhi yi phyag rgya chen po// srid dang myang 'das kun gyi gnas lugs// dzambu'i chu bo'i gser gyi mdangs 'phrog /rnam mang rigs kyi bye brag mtshon nus// rdo rje pha lam ind+ra nī la// ke ke ru dang padma rā ga /ma ra ka ta chu shel las bskrun// stong nyid mi 'gyur rdo rje'i ra bar// byang sems padma'i zlum rdzing 'khor yug /mdo dang sngags kyi bang rim drug brtsegs// rgyal ba'i zhing khams bkra shis sgo mang*// dngos grub bdud rtsis kun nas gang ba'i// mos gus srog 'khor bum pa'i steng na// sa chen bcu gsum gdugs kyi rtse la// 'khor ba'i gdungs skyob phrin las char khebs// smon lam yid bzhin tog gis rab brjid// gzung dang 'dzin pa'i snang ba ji snyed// bsam pa skad cig rang gzugs zil gyis// gnon par nus pa'i zla ba nyi ma// lham mer gsal ba'i mchod rten chen po// yid bzhin nor bu rang sems ngo mtshar// kun gsal lam gyi phyag rgya chen po// chos phung brgyad khri bzhi stong dgongs gcig /zangs dmar brdungs dang 'phrul dang lugs grub// mi rtag 'chi ba skyo shas mtshon nus// ba gam ngos la mu tig dmar po// bai ḍūrya dngul man shel byi ru// 'khor ba'i nyes dmigs gsal bar brda sprod// bar bar dag na me shel dung dang*// nges 'byung lhag bsam ind+ra rnyil spug

/byams pa'i g.yu dang rdo rnying gis spras// theg chen sems bskyed glang chen snol ma// gzhan don myur 'gro rta mchog zung dang*// 'dod yon dug len rma byas mdzes pa// don dam byang sems shang shang sgra sgrog /ma dag zhing sbyong padmo'i zlum tshigs// dag pa lha sku'i pho brang drug 'degs// sems bskyed dmigs yul mi zad brgyad cu// ka ba brgyad cu smon pa'i sems bskyed// mchod lha brgyad cu 'jug pa'i sems bskyed// ngos logs zur ldan lha yi pho brang*// dbang gi rgyal po'i gnas lugs 'di ya mtshan// kun mkhyen 'bras bu'i phyag rgya chen po// lhan cig skyes sku skyob pa nyag gcig /dngul dkar gar bu'i rang gzugs la byon// rtsa khams sum cu rtsa gnyis dag pa'i// bde mchog bzhi dang mkha' 'gro bcu drug /rdo rje phag mo bcu gnyis skur ston// ze rog rtse 'khor rnams la bzhugs so// bka' brgyud bla ma'i bang rim ngos la// rdo rje 'chang bzhi mkha' 'gro bcu drug /grub chen brgyad dang tilli nā ro// mar pa mi la sgam po mtha' rtsa// skyob pa dbon dang gcung dang thog kha// mtshams bcad bcu gnyis nyer brgyad nyer gnyis// don grub waṃ dang chos rgyal rin chen chos rgyal dbang gi mtshan ldan// rgyal dbang kun dga' rin chen la sogs// bcu phrag bzhi dang g.yas g.yon logs la// grub chen brgyad cu bang rim 'og mar// rgyud sde bzhi po'i lha rnams kun tshang*// chos skyong srung ma'i bang rim dang bcas// sku bzhi rgyal ba'i zhing 'di ltad mo che// e yi stong nyid chos kyi 'byung gnas// rdo rje'i sa dang padma'i rdzing bu// 'dab ma nyis brgya lnga bcu rtsa drug /bang rim drug ldan khang brtsegs yid 'ong*// ngos dang logs dang zur gyis rab mdzes// lha phrug nam mkha' lding gis rab brgyan// rin chen mang po'i brgyan gyis rnam bkra// rnam pa kun gyi mchog dang ldan pa'i// ka bas bteg pa'i thog phibs gzhal med// rdo rje lus kyi rtsa rnams mtshon nus// waṃ yig bde chen 'od gsal lha sku// nyis stong brgyad brgya lhag par bzhugs pa'i// chos skyong bang rim lha tshogs nyis brgya// brgyad cu rtsa gnyis lhag dang bcas pa// bya rgyud brgya dang bdun cu rtsa bzhi// spyod rgyud stong dang nyis brgya dang dgu// rnal 'byor lha tshogs sum brgya rtsa bzhi// bla med lha grangs lnga brgya lnga bcu// grub chen bang rim brgya dang brgyad cu// skyob pa'i sku yis kun la khyab ste// e waṃ zung 'jug rten mchog e ma mtshar// de 'dra'i bkra shis sgo mang gi// mchod rten yid 'ong ngo mtshar can// bskrun mkhas bzo bo 'jigs med pa// srid pa gsum na shin tu dkon// 'on kyang mtshe'u kha bde ldan gyi// lha yul khang bzang nyams dga' bar// dngos po'i rang gzugs rig pa de// lugs dang brdungs dang 'phrul rtsed du// ston mdzad sprul pa'i gtso bo ni// skyob pa kun dga' rin chen zhes// 'dzam gling grags pa de yin no// de ltar mchod par brjod nas/

'dir dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyi thugs rje las/ rdo rje 'chang mi'i gzugs su byon te snyigs ma'i 'gro ba mgon skyabs dang bral ba rnams kyi gnyen gcig por gyur pa/ 'bri gung 'jig rten gsum gyi mgon po zhes yongs su grags pa de nyid slar yang mthil gyi khri thog bcu gsum pa'i dus 'byon par zhal gyis bzhes shing*/ grub chen u rgyan padma 'byung gnas kyis kyang shin tu gsal bar lung bstan pas/ skyob pa nyid kyi thugs kyi sprul par gdon mi za ba'i spyan snga rin po che kun dga' rin chen chos kyi rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po'i zhal mnga' nas/ 'di nyid kyis sngon 'jig rten mgon po'i mdzad pa ji lta ba bzhin du/ lha mi'i mchod pa'i zhing*/ rten mchog bkra shis sgo mang snga ma rnams las kyang*/ rgya dpangs lha grangs ches lhag pa zhig ma nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can mtha' dag myur du sdug bsngal las grol/ bde ba dang ldan/ bla na med pa'i byang chub thob pa'i phyir du/ bstan pa yang yun ring du gnas pa'i rten 'brel du yang byin gyis brlabs shing dgongs pa sngon du btang nas bskrun par mdzad pa ni/ rnam thar chen mo dang*/ dkar chag chen mo ltar yin pa las/ de dag gi nang bzhugs/ chos kyi sku'i ring bsrel dang*/ sku gdung yungs 'bru lta bu dang*/ sku gdung sha ri raṃ dang*/ ring bsrel phal la sogs pa ji ltar bzhugs pa/ rin po che'i bka' khyab/ phyag g.yog pa rnams kyis phyag len du thebs pa'i zin bris ltar/ phyi ma'i gang zag gzhan gyi don du bri bar bya ste/ thog mar mnyam med sgam po pa'i sku 'dra rgya mtho gang pa lugs phud du byon pa'i tshe/ ngo mtshar ba'i ltas ni dkar chag rgyas pa ltar yin la/ de'-i dbu gtsug na de bzhin gshegs pa'i ring bsrel/ 'jig rten mgon po'i dbu zhwa/ tilli pa nas phag mo gru pa yan gyi gdung rus ring bsrel/ jo bo'i gdung rus dbu lo// skyob pa nas dbang rin po che'i bar rang re'i brgyud pa'i ring bsrel mang ba/

phag mo gru pa'i dbu lo dang na bza'/ thams cad mkhyen pa karma pa bdun rgyud kyi gdung rus/ rgyal ba yang dgon pa'i 'phel gdung*/ 'khor lo sdom pa yab yum gyi byang sems/ phag mo gru pa'i 'jag spyil gyi rtsa/ rgya nag ri bo rtse lngar rdo las grub pa'i 'jam dbyangs rigs lnga'i sku sha/ ri bo rtse lnga'i mchod rten rang byon/ bal po'i mchod rten bya rung kha shor gyi sa/ 'phags pa wa ti'i shing lo/ bde gshegs phag gru'i dbu lo dang na bza'/ thams cad mkhyen pa karma pa bdun brgyud kyi gdung rus na bza'/ jo bau rje'i gdung rus/ gling ras kyi gdung rus/ grub chen u rgyan pa'i na bza'/ yang dus gsum mkhyen pa'i na bza'/ mar pa dbu yag gi sku sha grub chen mi dra dzo ki'i sgom thag dum bu/ paṇa chen shākya shrī'i dbu skra/ gu ru chos dbang gi sku sha ye shes mtsho rgyal gyi sku rags/ rje btsun mi la'i na bza'/ yang phag mo gru pa'i zhal chas/ byang chub kyi shing*/ bsil ba'i tshal gyi shing rnams bzhugs/ ma cig lab sgron/ yum bdag med ma/ ye shes mkha' 'gro bsod nams dpal 'dren gsum gyi dbu skra/ jo bo rje'i dbu skra/ gdung rus gdung sol/ bram ze skye ba bdun pa'i sha/ rgya nag ri bo rtse lnga'i 'jam dbyangs rigs lnga'i sku sha'i rdo/ rgya nag gi sindhu ra dang yang sindhu ra dkar po ti se nas byung ba/ tilli'i phyag mdzub/ bram ze skye ba bdun pa'i sha yang gter ston padma gling pas bsam yas mchims phu'i mchod rten dbus ma'i 'og nas bton pa'i bram ze skye bdun gyi ril bu/ gzungs sngags kyi rim pa bka' brgyud bla ma'i mtshan 'bum/ grub chen brgyad sogs kyi mtshan/ bde dgyes sogs gsang sngags kyi lha thams cad kyi mtshan snying po rtsa sngags ji snyed pa gzungs chen sde lnga sogs/ nor rgyun ma sogs lha mo'i gzungs kun/ mgon po nor lha'i gzungs sogs go rim ma 'chol bar bzhugs/

'khor pad la gnod sbyin 'khor lo/ rin po che dang sman dang*/ 'bru dang zas sna sogs rtsi bcud mtha' dag tshang ste/ sgo mang dngos gzhi'i nang bzhugs thams cad kyi sna yongs su tshang bar bzhugs pa'o/// /
